name: ADE20K Scene Parsing Benchmark
description: Semantic segmentation benchmark for scene parsing, providing pixel-level annotations for indoor and outdoor scenes across many object and stuff categories.
evaluation_method: mean Intersection over Union (mIoU), pixel accuracy, and related segmentation metrics
typical_sota_score: roughly 45% to 55% mIoU depending on backbone and evaluation protocol
notes: Commonly used for semantic scene understanding and dense prediction. The dataset is known for its broad category coverage and pixel-wise labeling.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
